note: Grader only. Never pass this file or its contents to a solver session. Derived by hand from data/demo.sqlite (France 20/10, Germany 40/20, Canada 60/30) and data/contracts.json. adjusted_bounce = bounce * (1 - ctr/100): France 18, Germany 32, Canada 42. bounce_percentile = percent_rank ascending over ALL sessions: 0.0, 0.5, 1.0.
tolerance: Numeric values must match within 0.01 after rounding; all listed values must be present. Citation quality is recorded separately and is not part of the numeric match.

eu_avg_adjusted_bounce.rationale: France and Germany are EU members: (18 + 32) / 2.

eu_global_ranking.rationale: Ranked over all three sessions before filtering: France 0.0, Germany 0.5. Ranking after filtering (0.0, 1.0) is wrong.

non_eu_max_ctr.rationale: Canada is the only non-member row.

eu_top_percentile.rationale: Germany, session id 2, percentile 0.5 over all sessions.

euro_currency_avg_ctr.rationale: France and Germany use the euro; Canada uses the Canadian dollar: (10 + 20) / 2.

g7_total_bounce.rationale: France, Germany and Canada are all G7 members: 20 + 40 + 60.
